messages:
Ava Chen: Heads-up — we need to lock the postmortem/retro this week for the DB fail incident. Can folks confirm availability and section leads? Proposed: Tue 10:00 PT / 60m. Agenda draft below. Please flag conflicts and volunteer for sections.

Diego Martinez: Tue 10:00 PT works for me. I can take timeline & facts.

Priya Patel: I'm oncall Tue morning (rotation), could do Tue 11:00 PT instead. If we keep 10:00, I can join for the last 30m.

Ben Liu: 10:00 PT is better for me too. I can run the actions + owners section.

Ava Chen: Noted — @Priya if you can only make the last 30m that's fine; we'll prioritize the action triage then. Do we have a scribe?

Marta (reminder-bot): Calendar event: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/pm-db-fail-retro — proposed Tue 10:00 PT. RSVP + indicate "scribe" in the event notes to claim it.

Ava Chen: Agenda (60m):
```
- 5m check-in + quick wins
- 15m timeline & facts (Diego)
- 15m technical root cause recap (infra)
- 15m what went well / what to improve (all)
- 10m action items + owners (Ben)
```

Diego Martinez: I will drop the timeline slides into the doc by EOD today — fwiw I have logs and span links for the 02:14-02:23 window.

Priya Patel: If we do 60m, can we trim "what went well" to 10m? I'm fine to drop into the tail when I'm oncall.

Ava Chen: Good call — trimming that to 10m and giving actions 15m. Updated agenda above.

Ben Liu: I'll prepare the action tracker template. Quick ask — can someone own verifying the rollback cadence item? I don't want to be sole owner.

Diego Martinez: I can pair on rollback cadence with Ben.

Priya Patel: I'll volunteer to verify runbook clarity and playbook gaps after the retro (will carve time in my oncall handover).

Ava Chen: Perfect. Owners so far:
- Timeline & facts: Diego
- Tech root cause recap: infra (TBD — tagging infra channel)
- Runbook/playbook verification: Priya
- Actions + owners: Ben + Diego (rollback cadence)
- Scribe: open — pls mark in event if you're taking it

oncall-bot: Reminder — Priya oncall 2026-03-18 07:00-19:00 PT.

Marta (reminder-bot): Ping in 24h before the meeting to confirm scribe and final slides.

Ava Chen: Quick prework ask: add 1 slide or a short doc note with your top 2 incident takeaways by Monday EOD. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/pm-db-fail-retro-draft

Diego Martinez: Added timeline + logs link. :thumbsup:

Ben Liu: I'll add the action tracker and mark the rollback item as "Ben/Diego".

Priya Patel: I'll do the runbook notes after my handover and post to the doc. If anything changes on time I'll update here.

Ava Chen: Thanks all — leaving this pinned. If no major objections by EOD Monday we'll set Tue 10:00 PT as final.

Ben Liu: Sounds good.

Diego Martinez: 👍

Priya Patel: If I have to miss, I'll post a quick blurb with playbook gaps so the team can discuss without me.

Ava Chen: Appreciate it. Closing the loop later today with an updated calendar invite and final scribe owner.
